newFlow.name: LLM-First Goal Processing Architecture
principles: LLM manages all conversation state and flow logic
App is a thin presentation layer only
All decision-making happens in the LLM
Single source of truth: LLM conversation history

conversationManagement.description: LLM maintains full conversation context and decides next actions
conversationManagement.implementation: Use structured outputs with conversation_state object

stateTracking.description: LLM tracks SMART criteria progress, confidence scores, and missing elements
stateTracking.implementation: Return state updates in each response

flowControl.description: LLM decides when to ask questions, provide examples, or complete the process
flowControl.implementation: Use action_type field: ask_question, show_example, update_goal, complete

dataStructure.description: LLM returns structured JSON with UI rendering instructions
dataStructure.implementation: Standardized response format with display_elements array

interactionPattern.userInput: User provides goal or answers question
interactionPattern.appRole: Send raw input to LLM with conversation history
interactionPattern.llmProcessing: Analyze input, update internal state, decide next action
interactionPattern.llmResponse: Return structured response with UI instructions
interactionPattern.appRendering: Render UI elements based on LLM instructions only

llmResponsibilities: Maintain complete conversation state and history
Analyze goals and identify SMART criteria gaps
Generate contextual questions based on missing information
Calculate and track confidence scores for each criterion
Decide when goal is sufficiently refined
Provide examples and educational content when needed
Handle all conversation flow logic and branching
Generate the final SMART goal with all components
Manage user learning preferences and adapt accordingly
Validate user inputs and provide feedback
Orchestrate the entire goal refinement process
appResponsibilities: Display UI elements as instructed by LLM
Send user inputs to LLM without modification
Render chat messages in chronological order
Handle basic UI interactions (button clicks, form submission)
Maintain WebSocket or streaming connection for real-time updates
Store final results when LLM indicates completion
Provide visual feedback for loading states
Handle errors and connection issues gracefully

extractionStrategy.principle: No extraction - pass everything to LLM

implementation.userInput: Send raw text directly to LLM
implementation.llmResponse: Parse only the top-level structure (action_type, display_elements)

parsingStrategy.principle: Minimal parsing - only for UI rendering

requiredParsing.action_type: To determine UI layout (chat, form, completion screen)
requiredParsing.display_elements: Array of UI elements to render
requiredParsing.ui_state: Basic state for UI (loading, error, success)

llmHandledParsing: SMART criteria extraction from user input

implementationSteps.description: Design comprehensive prompt that handles all SMART goal logic
Single endpoint that passes user input and returns structured response
Remove all state management logic, only render LLM instructions
Add real-time streaming for better UX

benefits: All logic in one place (LLM prompt)
Easy to modify behavior without code changes
Better conversation flow and context awareness
